name: GOOSE interlock publisher interface
summary: Publishes the equipment states used by the assigned remote interlocking function.
description: Publishes the equipment states used by the assigned remote interlocking function. Digital substation interfaces carry measurements, status and control information between primary equipment and protective devices. Measurement streams, event messages and time synchronization are separate dependencies even when they share an Ethernet network.

In a digital substation bay, a merging unit digitizes local measurements and a protective relay subscribes to the assigned data stream. The command return path and communication-health indications are drawn separately. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Interlock source states” at the input and “Published interlock data” at the output. An event-message link does not replace mechanical restrictions.
